steps.text: Talk to Alan, Tal Teok Temple north of Tal Teklan
Talk to Alan again.
Inspect the egg
Talk to King, the bartender in The King's Inn west of the bank.
chat: 2. Scrumpty Rumpty fell off a wall!.

steps.text: Talk to Acatzin in the inn
chat: 1. I can talk to the blacksmith!.

steps.text: Talk to the blacksmith, west of the inn.
Repair the whetstone with a hammer; one spawns in the building. Keep it!
Talk to the blacksmith again for Acatzin's axe, then repair it on the whetstone.
Return to Acatzin. Take a bowl from the table before you leave.
Fill the bowl with water at the fountain outside.
Talk to Nezketi at the temple directly south of the inn for an empty cup.
chat: 1. I can get you some tea!.

steps.text: Pick damiana leaves from the damiana directly outside of the south-eastern walls of Tal Teklan.
While you are there, head a bit further south-west and pick up the two planks.
Add the damiana leaves to the bowl of water.
Head to the Tal Teklan General Store just south of the bank.
Use the bowl on the oven to boil the damiana water.
Use the bowl on the empty cup, then return to Nezketi with the damiana tea.
Talk to Kauayotl, outside the eastern entrance of Tal Teklan.
chat: 1. I see. Well, maybe I can help out with that?

steps.text: Return to the blacksmith; pick up the hammer if you dropped it.
Search his workbench for 20 iron nails.
Pick up a saw at Arcuani's Archery Supplies just south of the blacksmith.
Repair the racing cart next to Kauayotl.
Talk to Kauayotl again.
Return to Tal Teok Temple and speak to any of King's men.
Large egg:
Search the eggs at the chicken farm directly south.
Defeat the large chicken and search the eggs again.
Dragon egg:
Head to the bank for some combat equipment and dragonfire protection.
Enter the cave entrance to the Dragon Nest to the east (marked on the world map as )
Search the eggs in the south-east corner of the nest. Defeat the red dragon, who can be safespotted by using the eggs.
Search the eggs again and head back outside.
Jaguar egg:
From the Dragon Nest, run eastwards until you reach a campsite.

Search the eggs and defeat the black jaguar; it has routefinding capabilities, however it can be safespotted if you stand directly west of the Tropical tree closest to the river (RuneLite's Quest Helper will mark this square for you).
Search the eggs again and return to Tal Teok.
Speak to each of King's men to initiate a cutscene.

Put the egg together - players can hover over the puzzle piece icon to view the solution. When a piece is rotated in the correct orientation and placed in the correct location, it will stay in place indicating the correct placement.
Watch the final cutscene.
